purpose: Prepare a synthetic, paired GPT-6 Luna decision-model versus Jev evaluation. No inference has been run on the new corpus.
scope: Built-in category-based spam protection; arbitrary custom semantic policies are a separate contract.

models.candidate_label: GPT-6 Luna decisions through OpenRouter BYOK
models.candidate_route: Verify exact catalog identifier, decision-endpoint support, and user BYOK route before inference. Do not silently substitute a chat-completion model or another provider.

headers.X-OpenRouter-Description: DomDimaBot is a Twitch chat bot that helps make streams more engaging and fun.

openrouter.authentication: Future runner supplies Authorization from its sanctioned runtime environment; exports never contain credentials.
openrouter.byok: User states Luna BYOK is available. Confirm served route and BYOK accounting before spending; OpenRouter-reported cost alone may not include upstream BYOK spend.

contract.target: state.output assistant-role message; preceding context is state.input user-role JSON messages
contract.enforce_if: valid response, no error, latency_ms < 4000, max(selected category probabilities) >= 0.85, and max(selected category probabilities) > 1 - P(unsafe)
contract.otherwise: allow or uncertain; never enforce on a tie, invalid response, transport error, or late response
contract.timing_scope: Request-to-full-response transport latency. Does not prove the production end-to-end deadline, which includes queues, credit checks, and action execution.

legacy.role: Historical regression reference, reported separately. Supplemental historically had one repeat; new exports use two unless overridden. Preserve all original labels, including known policy disagreements.

expanded.languages: Broad multilingual coverage, including mixed language and non-Latin scripts; report actual per-language counts and outcomes.
expanded.split_unit: Entire family, scenario_group, and target-message text; none may cross development, holdout, or diagnostic splits.
expanded.diagnostics: Ambiguous cases have expected=false under the absent-if-ambiguous policy. Report separately from clear-case qualification.

comparison.pairing: Both models receive the same frozen cases, policy, categories, context, and repeat counts; only model selection differs.
comparison.missing_or_duplicate: Missing planned outcomes make the comparison incomplete; reject duplicate tuples, unknown cases/models, unexpected rounds, malformed timing, and mismatched request hashes.
comparison.independence: Repeats are not independent unique examples. Report distinct affected cases, per-case consistency, and paired outcomes alongside attempt counts.
comparison.selection: Use development only for any prompt or rule experiments. Freeze prompt and thresholds before holdout inference; do not select a threshold on the holdout.
comparison.qualification: A complete expanded holdout with zero observed returned false-positive judgments (including late responses) and strict improvement in timely positive attempts AND distinct timely positive cases over contemporaneous Jev may be labeled synthetic_holdout_candidate only. It does not authorize a production change.
comparison.cost: Sum each returned usage.cost once. Missing usage has unknown cost, never assumed free. Keep OpenRouter usage and upstream BYOK accounting separate.
comparison.limitations: AI-authored synthetic expectations, not moderator ground truth; small language slices and zero observed false bans do not establish safety, real-world accuracy, or probability calibration.

execution.next_phase: Confirm exact Luna decision model and BYOK routing, current prices, sanctioned credentials, and a bounded run budget before running a fresh paired comparison. No production moderation or deployment is part of this kit.
